detectors.description:
Math.mulDiv(uint256,uint256,uint256) (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol#123-202) has bitwise-xor operator ^ instead of the exponentiation operator **: 
	 - inverse = (3 * denominator) ^ 2 (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol#184)
detectors.rationale: The XOR is intentional: after removing powers of two, denominator is odd. (3*d) XOR 2 seeds an inverse correct modulo 16; successive Newton/Hensel iterations double precision to 256 bits. Exponentiation would break the algorithm. Independently enumerated all eight odd residues modulo 16 in slither-math-seed-check.json.

detectors.description:
Reentrancy in SpcxcSwapExecutor.processWeth(uint256,uint256) (src/SpcxcSwapExecutor.sol#112-131):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- weth.forceApprove(address(router),amount) (src/SpcxcSwapExecutor.sol#124)
	Balance read before the call:
	- balance = weth.balanceOf(address(this)) (src/SpcxcSwapExecutor.sol#116)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- require(bool,string)(weth.balanceOf(address(this)) == balance - amount,incorrect input spent) (src/SpcxcSwapExecutor.sol#129)
		- stale variable `balance`
	- require(bool,string)(spcxcOut >= minimum,insufficient actual output) (src/SpcxcSwapExecutor.sol#128)
		- stale variable `minimum`
detectors.rationale: The pre-call balances intentionally measure required asset deltas, not stale entitlements. processWeth is keeper-gated and nonReentrant, uses fixed tokens/router/recipient, checks exact WETH consumption and actual SPCXc increase, and clears router approval. Fresh tests force excess spend, fabricated output despite pre-existing destination funds, unexpected input top-up, post-transfer revert and keeper-authorized router callback; failures roll back balances/approval/cooldown.
residual_limits: Supported untaxed/non-rebasing assets and authentic fixed router remain trust assumptions; this does not dispose of the separate market-price/MEV risk.

Reentrancy in AerodromeVammHarvester.harvest() (src/AerodromeVammHarvester.sol#85-96):

	- pool.claimFees() (src/AerodromeVammHarvester.sol#89)

detectors.description:
Math.mulDiv(uint256,uint256,uint256) (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol#123-202) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
	- denominator = denominator / twos (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol#169)
	- inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse (node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol#192)
detectors.rationale: This is the full-precision mulDiv algorithm, not an imprecise reward-rate division. It first subtracts the remainder from the 512-bit product, making division exact, factors powers of two, merges the high product bits and multiplies by the odd denominator modular inverse. The flagged step is one of this exact division/inverse sequence; preserve it.
residual_limits: The fresh bounded caller fuzz checks rounding but does not exercise every full-width 512-bit arithmetic case; the inverse branch was inspected, not formally proved.
